arms.A: 10 density features per slice (log10 rho quantiles 0.05/0.10/0.25/0.50/0.75/0.90/0.95 among kept cells, mean, sd, kept fraction) + log10 cells per slide
arms.B: A + first 4 fPCA scores of the slice
arms.R: first 4 fPCA scores residualised on A inside each outer training fold; per slice only (combined would be p >= n)
